text:
elaine: Hey team — I sketched a lightweight dashboard for investigating prompt key health across models/routes/customers. Want quick feedback before I prototype. :eyes:
ashok: link? can you paste the main queries and the panels you want?
elaine: sure, thinking 4 panels: 1) 7d rolling key-coverage by route (unique keys / requests), 2) token-saved delta vs baseline per-customer, 3) top 20 decayed keys (by TTL misses), 4) model-level kernel fallback rate overlay.
terry: love that. For panel 2 we should show both absolute tokens saved and % of traffic where cache hit saved >0 tokens. otherwise big customers dominate.
jun: +1. For panel 1 can we bucket by prefix length? short prefixes behave differently.
elaine: good call. I'll add prefix-length buckets (<=32, 33-128, >128). Query draft for panel 1 (PromQL-ish):
```
sum by(route, prefix_bucket) (count_over_time(prompt_key_seen[7d])) / sum by(route) (count_over_time(requests_total[7d]))
```
ashok: quick note — our current keying pipeline normalizes whitespace but not punctuation; call that out in the panel subtitle. some hit loss is expected on customers that paste transcripts.
sam: infra-bot can you run a small sample to show kernel-fallback rates for gptx-13b vs gptx-70b for the last 48h?
infra-bot: scheduled job queued: kernel-fallback-sample (48h) for models [gptx-13b,gptx-70b]. results will be posted in thread. ETA ~12m. :gear:
jun: when infra-bot posts, can we also include KV-cache eviction counts per instance? that's where warmup strategy hits us.
kai: UX suggestion — add a tiny sparkline per-customer row for 24h so PMs can eyeball regressions without drilling in.
elaine: agreed. Also proposing two alert knobs: urgent when token-saved drops >40% week-over-week for top-10 customers, and warning when unique-key-coverage dips >20% in 6h window. thoughts?
terry: thresholds sound reasonable as starting defaults. we should make them per-customer-adjustable.
ashok: add a table that surfaces suspected keying anomalies: customers with high variance in prefix normalization differences (whitespace vs punctuation). we can auto-tag as "likely keying issue".
infra-bot: kernel-fallback-sample completed. posting summary:
- gptx-13b fallback rate: 1.2%
- gptx-70b fallback rate: 4.8%
- KV eviction spikes aligned with fallback spikes at 2026-03-15T04:00Z
- sample instance ids: inst-34, inst-41 (eviction at 03:58)
infra-bot: full artifacts: https://internal.redwood.ai/artifacts/kernel-sample/2123456789
elaine: thanks infra-bot. the correlation with eviction spikes suggests warmup windows too short for certain tenants. action item: extend soft-warmup TTL for tenants with >0.5% late-fallbacks.
sam: i'll open a tiny rollout to bump TTL from 30s -> 90s for the Canary tenant set. will monitor token-saved delta.
jun: also let's instrument per-route prefix-decay histogram so we can tune decay rates instead of global TTLs.
kai: can we make the dashboard exportable as CSV for support to append to customer tickets?
elaine: yes — will add an "export" CTA. final ask: anyone object if I prototype this in the dashboard workspace and share a link tomorrow?
terry: go for it.
ashok: thumbs up.
ajobs: ACTIONS: 1) elaine prototype dashboard + CSV export (due +24h), 2) sam rollout TTL bump to canary (in next 6h), 3) jun add prefix-decay histogram metric (P0 telemetry), 4) infra to follow up on full artifact analysis.
elaine: copied actions. I'll ping when the prototype link is ready. :thumbsup:
